spans.s:
निकट a. Near, close, hard by,
proximate.
--टः, --टं Proximity. (
निकटे is used adverbially in the sense
of ‘near’, ‘at hand’, ‘hard or close
[]
by;’ वहति निकटे कालस्रोतः समस्तभयाव
हं Śānti. 3. 2.).

निकम् {c10c} A. To desire
excessively, long vehemently.

निकाम a. [नि कम् घञ्]
1 Plentiful
copious, abundant; निकाजलां स्त्रोतोवहां
Ś. 6. 16.
--2 Desirous of.
--मः, --मं Wish,
desire.
--मं ind.
1 According to one's
wish or desire, agreeably to desire.
--2 To one's satisfaction, to the
heart's content; रात्रौ निकामं
शयितव्यमपि नास्ति Ś. 2 ‘I cannot even
sleep at ease or comfortably at
night.’
--3 Very much, exceedingly
निकामं क्षामांगी

; often used
as the first member of comp. when
it loses its final म्; निकामनिरंकुशः

निकरः [निकॄ भावादौ अप्]
1 A heap,
pile.
--2 A flock, multitude,
collection; पपात स्वेदांबुप्रसर इव हर्षाश्रुनिकरः

.
--3 A
bundle.
--4 Sap, pith, essence.
--5
A suitable gift, honorarium.
--6 A
treasure.

1 Winnowing corn.
--2
Lifting up.
--3 Killing, slaughter.
--4 Humiliation, subjugation.
--5
Insult, injury, wrong, offence; तीर्णो
निकारार्णवः

; 3. 44.
--6
Abuse, reproach, disrespect.
--7
Wickedness, malice.
--8 Opposition,
contradiction^1.
[1] Correction submitted by user ekalavya01 on 20190706. note: English word misspelled in text.

whet-stone; निकषे हेमरेखेव

.
--2 (Fig.) Anything
serving as a touch-stone, a test;
नन्वेष दर्पनिकषस्तव चंद्रकेतुः

.
--3 A streak or
line of gold made on a touch-stone;

; 5. 19.

निकषा N. of the mother of
Rāvaṇa or of imps in general. --ind.
 Near, hard, close by, at hand
(with acc.); निकषा सौधभित्तिं Dk.;
विलंध्य लंकां निकषा हनिष्यति Śi. 1. 68.
--Comp.
--आत्मजः a demon.

निकायः [नि-चि-घञ् कुत्वम्]
1 A
heap, an assemblage, a class,
multitude, flock, group in general;

.
--2 A congregation, school, an
association of persons who perform
like duties.
--3 A house,
[]
habitation, dwelling-place; काशीनिकायः
&c.
--4 The body.
--5 Aim, butt,
mark.
--6 The Supreme Being.
--7
Ved. Air, wind.

निकुंचनः A measure of capacity
equal to (1/4) of a Kuḍava (also निकुंचक).

[]

.

--2

--3 Vulgar.
--4

--ष्टं Proximity.

लिक्षा q. v.).

To throw or cast

.

.
--3 To deposit, place as deposit.
--4
To encamp.

--6 To give or hand over, grant,
bestow (on).
